value: What are the common features, instructional approaches, assessment methods and variables of published science-education conceptual-change research before the COVID-19 pandemic, and what should future studies do differently?

Reviews 50 conceptual-change studies published 2011-2021 and argues the field is dominated by physics topics, undergraduate samples, cognitive-only frameworks and quasi-experimental pre/post designs, and therefore should build affective and metacognitive variables into interventions and measure them qualitatively.

quote: This systematic review is aimed to explore the researches that established students’ conceptual change process, both studies that facilitate conceptual change and studies that determined learner characters influencing conceptual change.

Based on findings, the most noticeable trend in the current literature is that instructional studies in science education used theoretical and methodological frameworks that are now considered outdated.

value: Across the 50 reviewed studies, physics was the science domain most often targeted by conceptual change research, ahead of the other science domains.
quote: Physics disciplines have received more attention than other science domains

value: Newtonian mechanics was the single most frequently examined physics topic in the reviewed conceptual change studies.
quote: The most widely examined physics concept was Newtonian Mechanics.

value: Undergraduate students from a range of majors, not only science education students, were the most common participants in the reviewed studies.
quote: Most studies were conducted on undergraduate students with various majors, not only science education programme.

value: Quasi-experimental designs comparing treatments between groups dominated the reviewed conceptual change research.
quote: The majority of studies used a quasi-experimental study design

value: Method was dominated by pre- and post-testing of small groups with quantitatively analysed data.
quote: Another obvious trend is that research method used in these studies was dominated with pre- and post-test with small group and data collection was obtained and analysed quantitatively.

value: Nearly all reviewed studies framed conceptual change from a cognitive-only perspective, which in turn pushed them to measure conceptual change quantitatively - the review's main theoretical criticism of the field.
quote: The most significant theoretical limitation was that nearly all of the studies observed conceptual change from a cognitive-only framework which led into examining of conceptual change itself quantitatively.

value: Although the search window ran to 2021, the review found no conceptual change study published during the 2020-2021 pandemic period.
quote: Consequently, conceptual change study was not found in period 2020-2021.

value: Only five of the fifty reviewed studies examined the conceptual change of pre-service teachers or in-service teachers, leaving that population largely unstudied.
quote: From the review, only five studies that examined both pre-service teacher’s and teacher’s conceptual changes.
